svg.title: The Pay-Per-Lead Arbitrage Loop
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-pay-per-lead-arbitrage-loop; chapter number: 1; title: The Pay-Per-Lead Arbitrage Loop; subtitle: One niche, one brand, one ad account, leads resold to buyers who already pay for them; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Pick One Niche Worth $100+ Per Lead; value: Step 1; detail: One niche, one brand, one ad account. My First Million warns operators below $100 per lead struggle to copy the blueprint.; step: 02; label: Generate Leads at $18 to $50; value: Step 2; detail: Kelly Joseph's math at a $25 CPL turns $1k of spend into 40 leads. Media buying is the key skill in an arbitrage model (Billy Robinson).; step: 03; label: Price Backward from 2x to 3x Buyer ROAS; value: Step 3; detail: Resell at 1.5x to 3x cost. Hunter Ceroy sets every price so the client clears a 2x to 3x return and reorders. Joseph sells the 40 leads at $60 each for $2,400 revenue and $1,400 profit.; step: 04; label: Deliver with Speed-to-Lead Automation; value: Step 4; detail: AI SMS agents, three automated texts and two-minute call rules. Robinson demos the bot live and reports closing one in three against a $3,750 minimum order.; step: 05; label: Post Sold Leads Back Server-Side; value: Step 5; detail: Conversions API through Stape.io, which Joseph calls the moat. New buyers prepay, and delivery pauses when payment is 7 days late.; caption: Operators who left retainers report monthly books of $221K to $400K built on owned leads resold at a markup to buyers who stay above a 2x to 3x ROAS.; assumptions note: The 5-step order is an editorial sequencing of steps the practitioners describe. All dollar figures are attributed practitioner claims, not audited results.; note: Sources - Billy Robinson (NStq42nosUk, -_uHG2CwBjA), Kelly Joseph (muQkzU3fXJY), Hunter Ceroy (0Cfp-Fc0sag), My First Million (Poc5H6aVTlw).
